text:
matt: Heads-up — I'm seeing a spike in p95 token latency for the /chat/gen route after last night's runtime patch. Putting together an initial perf thread so we can iterate on dashboard metrics and kernel/batching hypotheses. Figuring out whether it's kernel selection or KV cache churn. cc @ingrid @kevin

ingrid: thanks — do you have the token-level waterfall traces? that helped last time. also what's the traffic change? :thinking_face:

matt: quick summary: p50 stable, p95 up ~40ms, p99 up ~120ms. throughput steady, error rate flat. profiler samples point at more time spent in `kv_fetch` and `kernel_dispatch` on longer sequences. no obvious increase in request volume.

kevin: could be batching heuristics — last deploy bumped `batch_window` to 12ms to increase throughput. might be hurting tails for short sessions. we should split metrics by sequence-length buckets (e.g., 0-128,129-512,513-1024,>1024).

sasha: suggestion for Console dashboards: add per-route + per-seq-length panels: p50/p95/p99 token-latency, tokens/s throughput, 5xx error rate. also a token-slice waterfall that separates: decode, kv_fetch, kernel_exec, io_wait.

matt: sample PromQL we used to validate p95 per route & seq-bucket:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket{route="/chat/gen"}[5m])) by (le, seq_len_bucket))
```
Also KV hit-rate:
```
sum(rate(kv_cache_hit_total{route="/chat/gen"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookup_total{route="/chat/gen"}[5m]))
```

ingrid: nice. please add `kernel_variant` tag (e.g., avx_fp16, triton_quant, fallback) to the token metrics so we can see if a fallback kernel is being used more.

kevin: ran a brief profiler across 2k requests: flamegraph shows kernel dispatch overhead spikes when sequence length crosses 1024 and we fall back to an unvectorized path. also seeing more KV evictions — prefix mismatch churn when clients use streaming chunking.

sasha: actionable: add these to the per-route KPI dashboard:
- p50/p95/p99 series split by seq_len_bucket and kernel_variant
- stacked area token-latency waterfall (decode | kv | kernel | net)
- throughput (tokens/s) and request rate (rps)
- 5xx rate and top error tags
- kv_hit_rate and kv_eviction_rate

alice: I'll prototype a layout in Console: left column latency quantiles, middle waterfall, right column throughput/errors + top kernel variants. will include heatmap for p99 across models/routes.

kevin: also propose an experiment: A/B between `batch_window=12ms` and `batch_window=6ms` on a dedicated pool for /chat/gen short sessions, capture token-level histograms + tail percentiles. I can run this and collect dashboards.

matt: deploy-bot shows runtime rollout last night:

```
deploy-bot: deploy completed: runtime v2.3.4 at 1785554380 — note: batch_window change applied to default pool
```

sasha: can we add an alert rule: if p95(token_latency) for any route increases >20ms for 10m AND kv_hit_rate drops >5% then page oncall?

ingrid: +1 for that alert. add a noisy suppression window for A/B experiments.

matt: proposed short-term plan: 1) add seq-length bucketing and kernel_variant dimensions to per-route KPIs in Console 2) instrument token-level kv_hit boolean and kernel fallback events 3) run A/B on batch_window with dedicated pool 4) dashboard + exec summary for PMs and eng leads.

kevin: I'll start the A/B and attach results to this thread. Expect initial numbers in ~2 hours.

alice: uploaded Console mock screenshot to the perf card (link): layout mirrors above. will add Prom queries for each panel.

sasha: tagging this as perf-750. any objections to a p99 heatmap split by model and route? helps prioritize which model variants are impacted.

ingrid: no objections. +1

matt: great work team — once we have A/B and token-slice histograms we'll decide whether to revert the batch_window change or adopt hybrid batching (short-session fast-path). I'll post follow-ups. :thumbsup:

kevin: FYI running the A/B now — sending token histograms to the new dashboard stream.

deploy-bot: experiment: ab-test created: /chat/gen batch-window 6ms vs 12ms (dedicated pool) id=exp-1785554385

matt: thanks — keep notes on any kernel_variant flips and kv eviction deltas.
